text: Then God told me, "Get a big sheet of paper and write in indelible ink, 'This belongs to Maher-shalal-hash-baz (Spoil-Speeds-Plunder-Hurries).' "
I got two honest men, Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah, to witness the document.
God told me, "Name him Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
Before that baby says 'Daddy' or 'Mamma' the king of Assyria will have plundered the wealth of Damascus and the riches of Samaria."
God spoke to me again, saying:
on the gently flowing stream of Shiloah And gotten all excited over Rezin and the son of Remaliah,
the wild floodwaters of the Euphrates, The king of Assyria and all his fanfare, a river in flood, bursting its banks,
water up to your necks, A huge wingspan of a raging river, O Immanuel, spreading across your land."
Listen, all of you, far and near. Prepare for the worst and wring your hands. Yes, prepare for the worst and wring your hands!
All your talk is mere talk, empty words, Because when all is said and done, the last word is Immanuel—God-With-Us.
God spoke strongly to me, grabbed me with both hands and warned me not to go along with this people. He said:
always afraid somebody is plotting against them. Don't fear what they fear. Don't take on their worries.
worry about The Holy. Fear God-of-the-Angel-Armies.
or a Boulder blocking your way, The Rock standing in the willful way of both houses of Israel, A barbed-wire Fence preventing trespass to the citizens of Jerusalem.

while I wait and hope for him.
I and the children God gave me as signs to Israel, Warning signs and hope signs from God-of-the-Angel-Armies, who makes his home in Mount Zion.
Consult the spiritualists. Why not tap into the spirit-world, get in touch with the dead?"
People who try the other ways get nowhere—a dead end!
they try one thing after another. When nothing works out they get angry, cursing first this god and then that one, Looking this way and that,
A blank wall, an empty hole. They end up in the dark with nothing.
